subject.title: fix(meeting-bot): avoid stale state during transcript and browser recovery

question: Should browser-managed Google Meet talkback remain fail-closed whenever microphone state is unknown, even when an existing user could previously start audio under that unverified condition?
rationale: This deliberately changes availability behavior for existing browser-managed sessions; tests establish the implementation but cannot decide the intended upgrade and safety policy.

options.title: Adopt fail-closed microphone readiness
options.body: Keep explicit unmuted observation as the requirement, after adding real Meet evidence that recovery works once health becomes available.

options.title: Preserve unknown-state startup
options.body: Retain the prior unknown-microphone behavior and limit the patch to transcript and tab-recovery correctness until a separate policy change is approved.

recommendation.title: Adopt fail-closed microphone readiness
recommendation.body: Keep explicit unmuted observation as the requirement, after adding real Meet evidence that recovery works once health becomes available.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged extraction and this follow-up branch place this person closest to the meeting-bot ownership and intended policy boundary.
